title: 😳 Nobody Expected THIS To Happen...
speaker: Jared (Click Capital)

macro_themes.view: Not a market-wide sell-off but a big rotation into defensives; AI demand and big-cap earnings remain strong, debt-laden neoclouds deserve more volatility.
~29% blended earnings growth and compressed P/Es (forward 19) mean earnings growth still overwhelms higher yields for now.
Agrees with Paul Tudor Jones that 2027 (or 2028) could be a challenging year/top as equity supply rises and buybacks fall.
Bond-doom sentiment was a contrarian signal; Treasuries rallied despite hot CPI and may be front-running easing.
Oil above $100 on Hormuz attacks adds inflation and uncertainty into the midterms; expect bouts of volatility for a couple of weeks.
Welfare spending and debt make the UK/Europe uninvestable for him; strengthens the case for staying invested in America.
